name: Sierra Leone

flag.description: Three horizontal stripes of green, white and blue.
flag.symbolism: Green represents agriculture and the mountains, white unity and justice, and blue the natural harbour of Freetown.

hook: Sierra Leone reads top to bottom like the view from Freetown: green hills, white beaches, blue harbour; Gabon has yellow in the middle.
trivia: Freetown was founded in 1792 as a settlement for freed slaves.
The name comes from the Portuguese 'Serra Leoa', 'lion mountains'.
